reason: Annotator-A v1.0 quality control produced answer_mode=MIX for 3000/3000 items, demonstrating a degenerate annotation instrument before any LiReF/component outcome analysis.
corrections: Clarify that MIX is reserved for cases where both external factual knowledge and nontrivial derivation are indispensable; it must not be a default.
Clarify that named concepts in answer options do not themselves supply the factual relation needed to select the answer.
Add synthetic examples outside the study dataset for RET, DER, and MIX.
Require a 48-item blind preflight; reject an annotator if any categorical feature has more than 95 percent in one level or parse validity is below 95 percent.
Write all corrected annotations to v1_1 filenames and never overwrite the failed v1.0 artifact.
